ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 12-15% high-intensity (white and light-grey) pixel coverage concentrated in localized clusters and distal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains discrete, high-contrast white circular clusters in the medial region; right lobe displays diffuse light-grey mottling concentrated in the superior-distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a central convergence; calculated internal angle of approximately 48-52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-10 pixels; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher frequency and magnitude of 'valleys' compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins tapering toward irregular, thickened distal endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast white circular clusters (rosettes) localized on the ventral surface of the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-colored linear streaks visible on the lower-central region of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular, dark-colored mass protrusions (3D pixel clusters) located at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
